csv_scope_of_work: Smith Comprehensive Renovation - Commissioning Services. The University is seeking an engineering firm capable of reviewing design documents, preparing commissioning specifications and inspecting constructed facilities to ensure proper Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing commissioning of the facility described in the attachment.
